description: PlyMove Storyboard turns a chess game into a learner-specific narrative. Paste a PGN and a target Elo to get opening context, a story arc, ranked critical chapters with causal sequences, what-if branches, and a main lesson. You can also explain a single FEN, compare candidate moves for a learner rating, or ask what if a different move had been played at a decision point.

defaultPrompt: Use PlyMove to turn this PGN into a visual chess storyboard for a 1600-rated player: [paste PGN]
What if I played Nc6+ instead of 24.Rxd4? Compare both lines for a 800-rated player: [paste PGN]
Analyze my game for a 1200-rated player and create an annotated PGN: [paste PGN]
